_meta.authored: 2026-10-21 by Claude (Opus 5.5) in this session, before any retrieval run on the full KU corpus
_meta.method: Each question was written from a specific source passage located by grep in pismo_kb_release_r2/kb_corpus (read-only). Labels use the same format as the frozen benchmark: {file, match} = a chunk is relevant when it comes from a KU built from `file` (and, for guide/changelog files, from that file's verbatim block) and its text matches the case-insensitive regex `match`. {ku, match} labels point at KU-generated content (curated lifecycle KU, removal register). Labels were verified mechanically by build_benchmark.py against the source file and the KU chunks; no label was changed after looking at retrieval rankings.
_meta.limitation: Questions and labels were authored and verified by the same model that built the KUs; there is no independent annotator.
